- When sentiment is strongly positive (≥ 0.67) in recent days, model tends to underpredict upward moves; adjust forecast upward by 0.5–1.5% for the next 3–5 days.
- When sentiment is strongly negative (≤ -0.33), model often overpredicts downward moves; adjust downward by 0.5–1.5% for the next 3–5 days.
- After a sharp price spike (e.g., +3%+ in 3–5 days), model frequently overshoots and overpredicts continuation; reduce forecast by 1–2% for the next 5–7 days.
- Model consistently underestimates mean reversion in 30-day horizon; if 30d forecast is below 68.0, add 0.5–1.0% to forecast for next 7–10 days.
- If sentiment history shows alternating +/– swings (e.g., 0.67, -0.33, 0.67), model tends to lag in direction; align forecast with sentiment trend 1–2 days ahead.
- For 30d forecasts, if model is below 67.0 and sentiment is neutral or positive, add 0.5–1.0% to forecast to avoid underestimating upward bias.
